newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia-Singapore bridge work to start in 98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia-Singapore bridge work to start in 98 - paper.

text.p: Work on a bridge to replace the causeway linking peninsular Malaysia to Singapore will begin next year, The Star newspaper reported on Monday.

The Malaysian Cabinet at a recent meeting had given its approval for the project to start and had also picked the consortium that would carry it out, the daily quoted Works Minister S. Samy Vellu as saying.
Vellu was speaking to reporters in the southern town of Pasir Gudang on Sunday.
Details of which companies would be involved in the project were not given.
The new bridge was mooted by Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
The neighbours are already building a bridge to link the two countries at another location.
